reason: The fiat.es 403 forced several Fiat models to leave price null and rely on IDAE for specs. The fallback rule (no press prices, use a readable T2 source, record the gap) was applied ad hoc and is not written down anywhere.

Blocked-page fallback had no rule for the listing page or for citing unread press. In #1077 the agent cited Diariomotor from memory without reading it; the reviewer flagged it. In #1069 the brand listing page read fine while product pages were blocked.
Adds the listing-page step and the rule against citing unread press, both shown by this episode's #1069 and #1077 review.
